jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**What We're Looking For**

At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.
  
  
This opportunity entails supporting technical staff by performing a variety of project-related coordination, tracking, and administrative duties such as tracking client deliverables and evaluation scores, maintaining schedules, organizing documents and documents requests, and technical editing and preparation of reports and minutes.
  
  
Coordinates tasks and provides professional project management support to one or more project teams in assigned discipline. Assists with administrative project functions throughout the project lifecycle from discovery and planning to delivery and close out phases.  
  
THIS ROLE WILL BE FULLY ONSITE AT LOS ANGELES INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT

**What You’ll Do:**

* Prepares and maintains project plans, tracks project progress, and prepares reports for clients or project stakeholders including evaluation scores, and deliverable tracking of submittals and reviews. Monitors and evaluates project timeline and activity and delivers updates to protect team.
* Assists in the management, maintenance, and distribution of project schedules in applicable software.
* Monitors, tracks, and files large amounts of project documentation. Uploads and downloads deliverable documents to and from client systems. Copies and/or scans project-related documents and coordinates the distribution to internal and external stakeholders.
* Supports the project and/or office quality plan and quality management system by documenting the performance of management and quality control reviews. Generates and updates the relevant QA/QC documentation and assists with the development and maintenance of the project filing structure.
* Coordinates project meetings including calendar scheduling, preparing or creating materials, publishing minutes, and maintaining documentation.
* Communicates basic issues, problems, or additional information to project managers and project stakeholders.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s Degree, or
* Associate’s degree and 2 years of relevant experience, or
* In lieu of education, 4 years of relevant experience

**What You'll Bring:**

* Strong proficiency in the **Microsoft Office Suite**, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Information**

jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

**Required Notices (California & Federal):**

GoldUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available as required by law.

GoldUnion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Background screenings and applicant information are handled in accordance with applicable laws.

The listed pay range reflects GoldUnion’s good-faith estimate for this position. Actual pay may vary based on lawful job-related factors. Commission and incentive earnings are performance-based and not guaranteed.

Offers of employment are contingent upon applicable lawful onboarding requirements and screenings.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.44 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in project management in retail or construction?

Experience:

* Project management: 1 year (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

***Breakform Construction, Inc***. is a full-service architecture and design firm, General Contractor, and Metal Fabrication specialist, dedicated to creating spaces that seamlessly blend function, beauty, and craftsmanship.

Originating as a metal fabrication company, Breakform Construction is renowned for its meticulous attention to detail and its use of raw materials such as glass, metal, wood, concrete, and landscape to craft timeless, authentic designs. We are based in Los Angeles and are looking for local candidates who can commit to a hybrid schedule.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized Project Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone of our project management team. In this central role, you will work closely with Project Managers and site superintendents to keep day-to-day operations moving efficiently, safely, and within budget.  
The ideal candidate bridges the gap between the field office and the corporate office, translating high-level project strategy into organized task execution, strict document control, and clear stakeholder communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Document Control & Administration***

* Manage critical project files, including contracts, permit applications, change orders, submittals, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Review shop drawings and contract documents to ensure updates are properly distributed to subcontractors and field staff.
* Maintain accurate compliance logs, including subcontractor Certificates of Insurance (COI) and safety documentation.
* Compile operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals and as-built drawings for final project closeout.

***Scheduling & Logistics***

* Assist in creating and tracking comprehensive project timelines and milestones.
* Coordinate the scheduling of subcontractors, vendors, utility tie-ins, and site walkthroughs.
* Order materials, track delivery logistics, verify packing slips, and manage site access constraints.

***Communication & Financial Tracking***

* Act as a point of contact between clients, engineers, architects, subcontractors, and municipal agencies.
* Prepare and distribute daily or weekly project status and productivity reports.
* Organize, schedule, and take detailed notes during client progress meetings.
* Assist with project cost tracking, verification of pay applications, and invoice processing.
* Monitor project expenditures against the baseline budget to flag potential cost overruns.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in construction administration, project support, or general contracting operations.
* Proficiency with Bluebeam and Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
* Solid grasp of standard construction workflows, building codes, and documentation processes (RFIs, submittals, change orders).
* Exceptional organization and multitasking skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy under tight project deadlines.
* Strong professional verbal and written communication skills for working with diverse stakeholders.
* Proactive, collaborative problem-solver with an eye for identifying bottlenecks or safety non-conformance early.
* Ability to split time between the office and active job sites, wearing required PPE on site.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Five or more years of experience in construction administration, project support, or general contractin operations.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (equivalent field experience may be substituted).
* Experience with Buildertrend.

**Job Details**

**Benefits**

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Retirement plan

**Schedule**

* 8-hour shift, Monday–Friday

**Experience**

* Construction administration / project support: 5 years (Preferred)
* Bluebeam: Required
* Buildertrend: Preferred

**Physical Requirements / Work Environment**

* N/A

Pay: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* relevant work: 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

#hybrid

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

jobs.title: Experienced Fleet Support Program Specialist
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Boeing Global Services** (BGS) is seeking an **Experienced****Fleet Support Program Specialist** to join their team in **Seal Beach, CA or Seattle, WA.**

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Primary BGS contact for issues identified by BCA partners (Fleet Chief Office, In-Service Supply Chain, engineering, customer support, etc.)
* Assists in analyzing post-production supply chain data to define reorder points and quantities
* Enters, tracks, monitors and coordinates customer material and delivery requirements and customer orders
* Assists in the analysis of supplier and/or customer data regarding products or services to include repair capabilities, capacity and performance
* Project management of fleet-wide issues consisting of short and long-term challenges requiring BGS supply chain support without an existing plan
* BGS SME on fleet supportability – Either know the answer or help direct to the correct team
* Multiple identifiers for supportability issues (Fleet Chief Office, engineering, service bulletins, AOG/sales, supply-chain health, etc.)
* Own development and project management of roll-out until final execution
  

  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* 3+ Years of experience in Supply Chain

* 3+ Years of experience in Project Management

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Experience with SAP
* Define metrics and tracking mechanisms
* Comprehensive understanding of the issue, criticality, root cause, and impact to customers
* Define support plan and complete path to execution
* Establish stakeholders, action owners, and communication rhythm

**Conflict of Interest:**  
Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company's Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary pay range: $90,000.00 - $129,950.00

  
  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Oct. 16, 2026**

jobs.title: Office Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**L.A. Hydro Jet & Rooter Services** is seeking a **Sales Coordinator** to join our team! With a family-friendly approach, we prioritize work-life balance—discover why leading businesses trust us and why you'll love working here!

**What Sets L.A. Hydro-Jet Apart:**

* **Competitive Pay:** $24.50 - $28.50 per hour, plus bonus program

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, vision, and dental
* **Retirement Plan:** 401K plan + match.

This position plays a critical role in driving revenue, supporting our field teams, and delivering an exceptional customer experience from the initial estimate through project completion.

**Position Summary**

The Sales Coordinator is responsible for scheduling approved estimates and bids for both the Jetting and Repair Departments. This role works closely with customers, technicians, dispatch, and management to ensure projects are scheduled efficiently and communicated effectively.

**WHAT L.A. HYDRO-JET NEEDS FROM YOU:**

* Review approved estimates and communicate project details with customers.
* Convert estimates into sold work and accurately document project requirements.
* Verify estimate pricing and scope accuracy prior to scheduling.
* Coordinate project scheduling with customers and property representatives.
* Maintain consistent follow-up communication through phone and email.
* Schedule pre-work inspections and coordinate project planning activities.
* Obtain permits and arrange DigAlert notifications when required.
* Ensure all customer notices and project-related communications are completed.
* Work closely with Dispatch to coordinate field staffing and project timelines.
* Respond to a high volume of inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Evaluate customer requests and prioritize emergency service needs.
* Assist in identifying plumbing service needs and routing work appropriately.

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Excellent organizational and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with field and office personnel.

L.A. Hydro-Jet and Rooter Service determines compensation based on labor market data across several U.S. geographic regions. The average earnings for this position range from **$24.50 - $28.50 per hour, plus bonus program**. Pay is influenced by factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: Quality Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
WelbeHealth is a value-based healthcare organization that's transforming the future of senior care by providing an all-inclusive care option to our most vulnerable senior population. We step in as the care provider and care planner that work to keep our participants within their communities, out of institutions, and cared for like family, all while receiving the healthcare and social services needed to thrive.

Under the supervision of the Quality Operations Supervisor, the Quality Operations Coordinator (QOC) will be responsible for delivering excellent support and service to our PACE market operations through a process of record review to ensure a complete and accurate participant medical record. Responsibilities will include collecting data, auditing participant electronic health records by utilizing comprehensive tools specific to the area of quality improvement, complete reporting and confirming all regulatory required elements. This role collaborates effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to promote the WelbeHealth values, team culture and mission.

**This role is different because the Quality Operations Coordinator at WelbeHealth:**

* Plays a direct role in the quality and accuracy of participant care, ensuring medical records are complete, accurate, timely, and compliant with regulatory requirements. Your work helps identify gaps in documentation and supports our care teams in maintaining the highest standards of quality for our participants.
* Combines quality auditing with meaningful process improvement, giving you the opportunity to identify trends and deficiencies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with clinical and operational teams to strengthen processes, improve documentation, and support regulatory readiness across the PACE organization.

**We care about our team members. That's why we offer:**

* Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
* 401K savings + match
* Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
* And additional benefits!

**On the day-to-day, you will:**

* Identify potential deficiencies, facilitate, and monitor appropriate corrections to ensure data integrity in the EHR. Monitor participant medical records for complete and timely documentation and promptly report to Quality Operations Supervisor when policies and procedures are not being followed
* Participate in team documentation, process improvements and other QO team initiatives
* Conduct medical records audits to ensure all required documentation is timely and accurate
* Assist with WelbeHealth audits by preparing documents for desk review submission (universe lists) as well as assist with EMR navigation and impact analysis
* Review and reconcile assigned regulatory logs
* Complete all required tasks in a timely and accurate manner
* Complete required investigations and notifications

**Job requirements include:**

* Associate's degree preferred; may substitute three years' experience in lieu of education
* Minimum two (2) years' work experience in a healthcare setting or related areas
* Familiarity with healthcare quality standards, auditing, regulatory requirements, documentation, and maintaining operational controls in a regulated environment
* Experience working with grievances, complaints, appeals, or member/provider issues within a healthcare, health plan, managed care, PACE, or other regulated healthcare environment is highly desired
* Bilingual is a plus
* Ability to multi-task in a challenging environment is necessary; Excellent communication, listening, and organization skills
* Extensive MS office suite experience (Intermediate to advanced level proficiency is desired)

If you're detail-oriented and passionate about healthcare quality, auditing, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you!

**COVID-19 Vaccination Policy**

At WelbeHealth, our mission is to unlock the full potential of our vulnerable seniors. In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. WelbeHealth maintains required infection control and PPE standards and has requirements relevant to all team members regarding vaccinations.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**

At WelbeHealth, we embrace and cherish the diversity of our team members, and we're committed to building a culture of inclusion and belonging. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. People seeking employment at WelbeHealth are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), pregnancy or other status protected by applicable law.

  

**Beware of Scams**

Please ensure your application is being submitted through a WelbeHealth sponsored site only. Our emails will come from @welbehealth.com email addresses. You will never be asked to purchase your own employment equipment. You can report suspected scam activity to fraud.report@welbehealth.com

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT DOT.CARDS**
===================

dot.cards is the digital business card of the future. We produce premium networking hardware that pairs with a software platform that lets anyone share their contact info, in seconds. With 2.5M+ devices sold and 100M+ in-person connections facilitated, we have built strong momentum and clear product-market fit. We are now focused on scaling that foundation significantly across channels, products, and customer segments. Based in LA, we are a revenue-backed, fast-growing company entering our next phase of growth.

**THE ROLE**
============

We are hiring an Operations Coordinator to support the Head of Operations. This is a full-time, entry-level role for someone who wants to learn how a hardware company runs, from the factory to the customer.

Reporting directly to the Head of Operations, you will act as their right hand on operations: keeping inventory, suppliers, shipments, and reporting on track, and making sure commitments made get done.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
====================

* Coordinate with customer support, sales, procurement and the warehouse to support the custom product order process from order confirmation to delivery.
* Support weekly Amazon FBA replenishment: build the order, confirm inventory quantities, and review with Head of Operations for approval of shipping carton labels.
* Assist the Head of Sales by tracking action items from meetings, and follow up directly with owners on status and deadlines until each one is closed
* Track product development status, collect prototype and production quotes, sample shipments, follow up on action items and keep the product development tracker current.
* Coordinate monthly sales and operations planning (S&OP) readiness across departments and schedule meetings accordingly.
* Write and maintain SOPs for recurring operations workflows and flag any workflow that has not been written down yet.
* Coordinate in-house sample production, prioritize production schedule maintain inventory levels and document most effective customization parameters.
* Maintain one running list of open items with owner and due date and flag anything overdue or at risk.
* Check vendor invoices and forward them to accounts payable and receipts to our expense system
* Set up new SKUs, bundles, and maintain item master data in our document control database.
* Handle office facilities requests, including cleaning and other vendors and landlord requests
* Draft decks, spreadsheets, and briefs for review
* Order lab and office supplies and keep them stocked

**WHAT YOU WILL LEARN**
=======================

* How a hardware company runs operations end to end, working directly with the Head of Sales and Operations
* Supply chain and procurement with overseas manufacturers, from purchase order to delivered goods
* 3PL fulfillment and inventory planning across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop
* How operations reporting drives purchasing and planning decisions

  **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
  ===========================

**Required**
------------

* 1 to 3 years of experience in an operations, logistics, coordinator, or executive assistant role, ideally in a fast-moving environment; also open to recent graduates and students in their final year of study with relevant internship or part-time experience
* Interest in supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing, through coursework, internships, or work experience
* Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets: comfortable with formulas, pivot tables, and building trackers from scratch
* Detail-oriented and organized, comfortable juggling multiple trackers, deadlines, and follow-ups at once
* Comfortable following up with people, including holding others accountable to deadlines they have committed to
* Clear written communicator who can draft a professional email or message without heavy editing
* Reliable, shows up, and follows through without needing reminders
* Comfortable asking questions and flagging problems early rather than guessing
* Able to lift and pack boxes up to 25 lbs

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, or a 3PL or warehouse management portal

**COMPENSATION & DETAILS**
==========================

* $29.00 to $34.00/hour

Welcome to Our Place. We believe that sharing a home-cooked meal is the very best way to connect. That’s why we create products that simplify home-cooking; it’s why we celebrate traditions with families given, chosen, and found; and it’s why we share those stories with you, directly from the people and places where they originate.

The Social Media Coordinator/ Content Creator reports to the Head of Social and is responsible for executing high-impact, social-first video content that drives engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth across Our Place. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, with ownership of day-to-day TikTok content creation, video production, community-driven initiatives, specific Founder-led content, and platform growth strategies. **We have a hybrid working culture and are looking for this person to be on site 2 - 3 times a week at our brand new Our Place headquarters in West Los Angeles.**

  + Interpret the monthly social media calendar to develop and execute TikTok content aligned with strategy, marketing goals, brand, and messaging guidelines

  + Deliver a minimum of one TikTok per weekday and one Founder-led piece of content per month

  + Lead and manage the TikTok Bulletin Board and Instagram Broadcast Channel, driving community engagement initiatives tied to product drops and key brand moments
  + Support the Head of Social in community management across all social platforms by monitoring comments, engaging with followers, and identifying opportunities to drive engagement and brand affinity
* **Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  + Plan and deliver weekly TikTok content strategy meetings with the Head of Social, ensuring all content is produced ahead of scheduled posting dates and executed within established timelines and budgets
  + Partner cross-functionally with Social, Creative Production, and Marketing teams as needed.

### **Who you are**

* 1–2 years of experience in social media, content creation, or a related role
* Strong interest in social media, pop culture, food, and trends
* A genuine love of food and cooking, with an eye for how food can be captured beautifully and naturally on social
* Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, and evolving social platforms, with an understanding of what feels native to each
* Comfortable filming and editing short-form video content, with an eagerness to continue developing these skills
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines with guidance from the Head of Social
* Flexible and willing to travel locally to Our Place stores, events, shoots, and other locations to capture content as needed
* Adaptable and comfortable with shifting priorities, quick turnarounds, and last-minute opportunities
* Action-oriented, proactive, and willing to jump in wherever needed
* Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and eager to learn and grow within the Social team

### **What we offer at Our Place**

* Competitive pay and real-deal equity — we want you to have a slice of what we’re building together
* A chance to share in our wins — all full-time team members are eligible for our discretionary annual bonus plan
* Benefits that actually benefit — top-tier medical, dental, and vision to keep you feeling your best
* Plenty of time off — generous PTO, and synchronized time off (we all log off together so you can actually rest)
* We invest in you — $500 a year for learning & development, plus an optional 401k plan so future you is covered
* All the kitchen treats — team member discount, an annual our place gift card, and of course, lots of our place goodies for your home
* A workspace worth leaving your house for — a beautiful office with a creative studio, multiple kitchens, and plenty of room for big ideas
* Tuesday lunches — catered meals so you can catch up with your teammates over something delicious
* A culture of connection — team events, activities, and an annual company retreat because we like hanging out together
* A team full of kind, thoughtful humans who actually care — because the people make this place

jobs.title: Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Americas)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (AMERICAS)**

Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.

As the **Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Americas),** you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across the United States, Canada, and Latin America. The region includes large, established customers as well as customers expanding Starlink across new countries, sites, and use cases. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.

Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and other products, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Across the Americas, this means operating across different markets, currencies, billing and tax requirements, logistics models, and customer needs while maintaining a consistent commercial strategy.

This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where the next opportunities and risks are, and make sure your team follows through.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead, hire, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists across the Americas
* Grow revenue across an existing book of enterprise resellers
* Help the team identify and close opportunities for customers to expand their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and products
* Build hardware and service forecasts that leadership can rely on, with a clear view of what will close, what may slip, and why
* Develop a clear view of performance and growth opportunities across the United States, Canada, and Latin America while accounting for differences between markets
* Work through billing, tax, payment, capacity, logistics, and activation issues when they are blocking revenue
* Partner with Sales, Channel Sales, Finance, Tax, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Logistics to move customer opportunities forward
* Align closely with regional Sales and Channel Sales teams so resellers hear a clear and consistent message on Starlink growth priorities
* Identify recurring issues that slow growth and work with the right teams to resolve them at scale
* Stay close enough to the work to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let the team run independently

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
* 6+ years in customer success, account management, sales, or another commercial role for a technical product
* 3+ years owning and growing a book of existing customers, with direct responsibility for revenue, retention, or expansion
* 2+ years of direct people management
* Experience managing enterprise customers across multiple markets or countries

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Strong track record of growing revenue within existing enterprise accounts
* Experience managing commercial relationships across the United States, Canada, and/or Latin America
* Commercial mindset with the ability to understand a customer's business, find opportunities, and turn them into revenue
* Experience leading people who owned customer and revenue goals
* Strong financial understanding, including pricing, billing, collections, and payment terms
* Experience working through complex customer issues across billing, tax, logistics, capacity, or operations
* Spanish language proficiency
* Clear and direct communicator who can work effectively across different countries and customer environments
* Experience in telecommunications, satellite, connectivity, networking, or another technical industry

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Must be willing to work onsite five days per week
* Must be willing to travel regularly throughout the Americas and to other SpaceX locations
* Must be available for early mornings, evenings, and occasional weekends to support customers across time zones and commercial deadlines
* Must be able to meet requirements for international travel

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
We dream big. We love food. We're building the next generation of marketing software, and our mission is to help the lifeblood of our communities, small businesses, specifically local restaurants and bars.  
Launched in 2015, SpotHopper has quickly become the leading all-in-one marketing and operations platform for in-house teams to use at bars and restaurants. We work with nearly 20,000 restaurants and are one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the country.  
SpotHopper's all-in-one marketing and operations technology helps independent restaurants tackle the challenges they face online from one easy-to-use platform, saving them time and money. The industry-leading solution enables operators to elevate their online image, increase exposure, bring in more customers, attract more qualified employees, and keep up with national chains.  
**Who We Are Looking For**

  

* Results- and goal-oriented individuals with a competitive hunter mindset
* Growth minded
* Thrive when given freedom and autonomy
* Proven track record of exceeding your quota in a high-velocity environment; please include quotas/ KPIs, quota attainment, and any achievements (President's Club, Summit Club, highest sales of the year, etc.) on your resume
* Passionate about food and people
* Go-getter mentality with ability to innovate and get things done
* Enjoy working collaboratively with management and other team members throughout the sales process
* Confident go-getters who are not afraid to pick up the phone or drop in the restaurant to speak with prospective clients
* Dedicated to contributing to the growth of your community and the SpotHopper brand
* Those who have worked in the service industry before, please include this on your resume

**What You'll Do**  
The full Account Executive position is perfect for those who have experience in sales, specifically in SaaS, marketing, full-cycle, hunter-oriented roles that incorporate cold outreach. Full AE starts their time with SpotHopper's world-class training process and then quickly jump into the field, meeting with owners and making sales.  
This role offers a built-in progression path as well as endless opportunities to move into management, training, and new roles that open within the company.

* Own the full cycle, from cold outreach to close
* Work closely with our amazing Customer Success team as they handle the majority of the post-sale work
* Focus on bringing new business, selling to locally owned bars and restaurants using a consultative approach
* Get into the field, meeting in person with owners demonstrating the SpotHopper platform and all our offerings, working with them to fill their needs
* Hold 1-4 meetings per day, in person at the bar or restaurant with the owner
* Cover a territory of roughly a 45-1-hour radius (this is subject to change, and is territory dependent)

**What We Offer**

* Compensation when starting as a full Account Executive: year one $100-125k OTE (Base $65-85k)
* + Many of our full AEs are in the $150-$200k + range by year two.
* Performance-based equity options
* $300 monthly stipend for operational expenses
* Healthcare, vision, dental, and life insurance
* 401K
* Unlimited time off if hitting quota consistently
* All sales reps receive a monthly stipend to spend on any and all local restaurants. We want our employees to be experts in the service industry and their market, and continue to help these small businesses any way we can.
* + AEs receive $500 per month

jobs.title: AI Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**About Fuel Cycle** :

Fuel Cycle empowers leading organizations with agile research solutions that deliver decision-ready insights — fast, flexible, and fully integrated. As a market research disruptor, our AI-powered Insights Platform is built for speed, precision, and scale. With cutting-edge tools and seamless audience connectivity, we help brands ditch the guesswork and make smarter, customer-led decisions at lightning speed.

**Why work at Fuel Cycle?**

Join a high-growth team where curiosity is valued, ownership is encouraged, and your work drives real-world impact. Whether you’re based at our Los Angeles HQ, New York City hub, working remotely across the U.S., or part of our global team in India, you’ll help shape the future of decision intelligence for some of the world’s most iconic brands.

**The Role:**

The AI Operations Associate is Fuel Cycle's internal AI transformation role — accountable for making every company function AI-native, starting with Sales and Marketing. This role begins by owning the GTM operations stack (Salesforce, marketing automation, pipeline data) and the AI workflows that sit on top of it, then expands scope to Finance and the broader internal operations surface as coverage deepens.

This is not a Revenue Operations seat with AI bolted on, and it is not an IT or process-documentation role. It is the person accountable for replacing manual, human-routed workflows with instrumented AI pipelines — across every internal function — and for measuring the result. When a workflow can be replaced by an agent, you build the replacement. When it can't yet, you fix the data and the process until it can.

The initial focus is GTM (Sales and Marketing), with Finance as a close collaborative partner from day one. Over time, scope extends to HR, Legal, Customer Success, and other internal functions as the playbook matures.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**GTM Operations (Initial Focus)**

* Own the operational tooling — Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and connected data sources — including configuration, data hygiene, and integrations.

* Design and ship AI-native workflows across the revenue lifecycle: lead scoring, opportunity enrichment, forecast rollups, marketing attribution, and pipeline health monitoring.

* Build and maintain BI dashboards that give Sales and Marketing leaders real-time visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, campaign performance, and funnel conversion.

* Deploy AI agents into the daily workflows of Sales and Marketing leaders so they can query, act, and decide without waiting on manual pulls or analyst turnaround.

**Finance Collaboration**

* Partner with Finance from day one on the data and systems that underpin the close cycle, forecasting, and budget rollups — ensuring a shared, trusted source of truth.

* Support Finance in identifying and automating repetitive workflows: month-end close preparation, variance analysis inputs, quote-to-cash process steps, and forecast consolidation.

* Serve as the systems and data authority for the annual planning cycle — territory design, quota setting, budget rollups, and forecast cadences — in close coordination with Finance leadership.

* Build the connective tissue between GTM systems and Finance systems so revenue data flows cleanly, without manual reconciliation.

**Broader Internal Operations (Expanding Scope)**

* Identify and prioritize AI automation opportunities across all internal functions — HR, Legal, Customer Success, IT, and others — as GTM coverage matures.

* Establish and own the internal AI operations playbook: how Fuel Cycle evaluates, deploys, and measures AI-native replacements for manual workflows company-wide.

* Champion AI fluency across internal teams — helping department leaders understand what is automatable, what isn't yet, and what the roadmap looks like.

* Partner with Product & Engineering on the underlying platform and MCP infrastructure that powers internal agent surfaces.

**Systems, Data & Measurement**

* Own the "single source of truth" standard across all functions you support — ensuring data is clean, definitions are agreed, and escalations over numbers are rare.

* Instrument every AI workflow you deploy with evaluation loops so quality, accuracy, and reliability are continuously measured.

* Maintain a clear, quantified view of manual hours displaced, workflow coverage, and time-to-answer improvement — and report it to leadership.

**Your Success Metrics**

* AI-Native Coverage — Percentage of routine workflows across supported functions executed or materially assisted by AI agents.

* Manual Hours Displaced — Dollar-equivalent time returned to GTM, Finance, and other operational leaders each quarter.

* Speed to Answer — Time from a leader's question to a trustworthy answer, whether via dashboard, agent response, or ad hoc analysis.

* Data Trust — Reduction in escalations and disputes over pipeline, attribution, revenue, and operational numbers.

* Function Coverage Expansion — Number of internal functions with at least one AI-native workflow deployed and measured.

**Who You'll Work With**

* Chief Product Officer / Chief AI Officer

* CRO and Sales leadership

* CMO and Marketing leadership

* CFO and Finance leadership

* HR, Legal, and other functional leaders (as scope expands)

* The existing AI Operations Associate (peer, focused on customer-facing teams)

* Product & Engineering partners who own the underlying platform and MCP infrastructure

**Core Skills, Competencies & Attributes**

* Strong systems thinker — able to hold Salesforce architecture, a marketing automation platform, a finance stack, and other internal tooling in view simultaneously and see the seams between them.

* Fluent in AI-native workflow concepts: agents, MCP, prompt engineering, evaluation loops, and human-in-the-loop design.

* Comfortable owning the "single source of truth" burden across multiple functions with competing priorities.

* Communicates

jobs.title: Internal Sales Representative (INS854)
jobs.description:
We're looking for an **Internal** **Sales Representative** to drive new business at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting and inbound lead handling through discovery, proposal, and close, and you will be a direct contributor to the revenue that fuels the company's growth.

This is a small business. This is a lean operation. You will build your own pipeline, run your own process, and manage your own systems without a supporting cast. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy over how you build pipeline, run your process, and close deals. If you are a self-directed seller who takes full ownership of outcomes, moves fast, and thrives without needing structure handed to them, this role is a strong fit.

**Why You'll Want to Join**

* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction, strong case studies, and a differentiated offering
* High-ownership sales role with full autonomy over pipeline, process, and how you close

**What You'll Work On**

**Outbound Prospecting and Pipeline Generation**

* Identify and research target accounts across U.S. companies that are strong candidates for offshore hiring
* Conduct outbound outreach via phone, email, and LinkedIn to generate pipeline without relying on inbound alone
* Build and maintain a healthy, organized pipeline of active prospects and follow up consistently without dropping threads
* Test and iterate on messaging, targeting, and outreach approaches to improve conversion at every stage

**Inbound Lead Handling**

* Respond to inbound inquiries quickly and qualify them accurately against the ideal customer profile
* Move qualified inbound leads through the funnel efficiently and with a high sense of urgency
* Ensure no inbound lead waits or falls through the cracks

**Discovery, Proposal, and Closing**

* Run structured discovery conversations to understand prospect needs, pain points, timeline, and fit
* Prepare and present tailored proposals that speak to the specific value Hire Overseas delivers for each client
* Handle objections confidently and move deals to close with a consultative approach
* Own the deal from first touch through signed agreement and handoff to customer success

**CRM and Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate, current records of all outreach, conversations, and deal status in the CRM
* Keep pipeline data clean and trustworthy so leadership has a real view of what is coming and when
* Track and report on key sales metrics including activity, pipeline, and revenue contribution

**What You Bring**

* Proven B2B sales experience with a track record of closing deals and generating revenue in a full-cycle or high-contribution sales role
* Self-directed and high-ownership with the ability to build and manage your own pipeline independently
* Strong spoken and written English communication skills with the confidence and presence to run sales conversations at a senior level
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business where processes are still being built and the answers are not always handed to you
* Organized and disciplined with clean CRM habits and consistent follow-through on every open opportunity
* Motivated by results and comfortable being measured against revenue targets

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or B2B professional services
* Background selling at a startup or founder-led company where you had to build as well as sell
* Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the business case for remote contractor models
* Experience with outbound sales tools such as Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar platforms

**How to Apply**

Please include:

* Your **updated resume**
* A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your B2B sales experience, and walking through how you approach building pipeline from scratch when there is no inbound lead flow to rely on

**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

If you want to own a full sales role at a fast-moving company where your results are directly visible and your decisions actually move the number, this role gives you the autonomy, the product, and the direct impact to do your best work.

**Application Process Overview**

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

* **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
* **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
* **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
* **Recruitment Interview** - Initial screening with our talent team
* **Executive Interview** - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
* **Client Interview** - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
* **Background & Reference Check** - Professional reference verification
* **Job Offer** - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Summerfield Tea Bar has been serving handcrafted tea and munchies across Southern California since 2015. We're growing fast, with six locations and more on the way, and we're looking for a creative, outgoing storyteller to become the face of our brand online.

**About the Role**

This isn't a behind-the-desk social media job. You'll be in front of the camera as much as behind it: interviewing customers, hosting videos, capturing the energy at our events, and turning it all into content that grows our community. You'll own our presence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn, keeping every account active, current, and on-brand. If you light up a room, love talking to people, and know your way around a camera, we want to meet you.

**What You'll Do**

* Be the on-camera personality for Summerfield, hosting videos, conducting customer interviews, and creating content that feels fun and authentic.
* Plan, film, and edit short-form video for Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, with YouTube and other platforms as opportunities grow.
* Manage and maintain all brand accounts (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn), making sure profiles, bios, links, highlights, and store info are up to date and accounted for.
* Drive follower growth and engagement through consistent posting, trends, community interaction, and creative ideas.
* Attend off-site events and pop-ups to capture behind-the-scenes footage, talk with guests, and create content on the spot.
* Engage with customers in person and online, representing our brand with warmth and hospitality.
* Photograph drinks, stores, events, and people for social and marketing use.
* Track what's working and share ideas to keep improving our content and reach.

**What We're Looking For**

* Hands-on experience filming and editing video in CapCut and Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Experience creating and posting content on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
* Background in photography and/or videography is a plus.
* A working knowledge of camera basics, including shutter speed, aperture, ISO, framing, and lighting. You don't need to be an expert; we'll help you grow the rest.
* A big, outgoing personality and total comfort being on camera.
* Natural people skills: you enjoy talking to strangers, putting customers at ease, and drawing out great stories.
* A hospitable, positive attitude that reflects our brand.
* Availability to work off-site events, including some evenings and weekends.
* Reliable transportation to travel between our SoCal locations and event sites.

**Big Pluses**

* Your own camera gear (camera, lenses, mics, lighting, gimbal). This is a major plus, not required.
* Experience with YouTube, LinkedIn, or other platforms.
* A portfolio or personal social account that shows your on-camera presence and editing style.
* Experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or lifestyle content.
* A love of boba and tea culture.

**Work Setup & Flexibility**

This is a hybrid role based out of our office in Brea, CA. You'll split your time between the office, our store locations, off-site events, and working remotely when it makes sense. We believe great content comes from people who feel balanced and energized, so we offer a very flexible schedule and real support for work-life balance. Event days may include some evenings and weekends, and we'll work with you to keep your overall schedule manageable.

Pay: $21.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brea, CA 92821

jobs.title: Sales Representative (Entry-Level B2B)
jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a **Sales Representative, Small Business Services.**

Are you ready to build a rewarding future? Uncapped commissions, lavish incentive trips, and career advancement are some of the ways.  

Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success?  
* Are you looking to join a fast-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.

In this role, you will work within a defined geographic territory that targets clients and prospects with 1-49 employees. You will identify and sign new clients for payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and more and sell additional solutions to existing clients. Daily, you will cultivate relationships, set appointments, gather leads from established business partners, assess client or prospect needs to present the best ADP solutions, and spend your time in the field closing business. Don't worry if you have no prior sales experience; we are known for our high-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest sales technology to set you up for success.

Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse to lose attitude are must-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment - all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.

Ready to #MakeYourMark? **Apply now!**

**To learn more about Sales at ADP,** watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales\_Videos

**What you'll do:** Responsibilities

* **Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.** You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
* **Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.** You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
* **Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family.** In addition to selling cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all business; you will make life-long friendships here.
* **Collaborate Daily.** You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.

**#LI-CD2**

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:** Required Qualifications

* **Positive Self-Starter.** You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection, manage your time well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in-person, and over the phone.
* **Agile Solution Seeker.** You're a problem solver who can find an answer, or a solution, even in times of fast-paced change.
* **Continuous Learner.** You're always learning, growing, and questioning how things were done in the past to make them even better.
* **Technology & Digital Acumen.** You are comfortable leveraging modern digital tools and platforms-including AI-to work smarter and more efficiently. You adopt new technologies quickly, use data to inform decisions, and continuously explore ways to enhance productivity and results through innovation.

A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:

One to two years of prior work experience or internships in Retail, Marketing, Business Development, Food Service, Insurance Sales, or another relevant industry, OR  

* Military experience We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.

**Bonus points for these:** Preferred Qualifications

Prior quota-carrying experience  

* Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**

* **Be yourself** in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
* **Belong** by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
* **Grow your career** in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
* **Continuously learn** through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Be your healthiest.** Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
* **Balance work and life.** Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
* **Focus on your mental health and well-being.** We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
* **Join a company committed to giving back** and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
* **Get paid to pay it forward.** Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

What are you waiting for? **Apply today!**

**#LI-CD2**

Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insu

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Territory:** Los Angeles & Inland Empire, California  
**Industry:** Licensed Cannabis  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are a licensed California cannabis brand looking for a motivated, relationship-driven **Outside Sales Representative** to grow our retail presence across the **Los Angeles and Inland Empire markets**.

This is a field-based sales role focused on developing relationships with licensed cannabis dispensaries, introducing our products to buyers and purchasing teams, growing existing accounts, and driving consistent sell-through.

The ideal candidate knows the California cannabis retail landscape, is comfortable walking into dispensaries and meeting decision-makers, and understands that successful cannabis sales are built on **relationships, follow-through, product knowledge, and consistent account management**.

Responsibilities

* Identify and develop relationships with licensed cannabis dispensaries throughout LA and the Inland Empire
* Prospect new retail accounts through in-person visits, phone, email, and industry networking
* Build relationships with dispensary owners, buyers, purchasing managers, and retail teams
* Present our brand, products, pricing, promotions, and wholesale programs to prospective accounts
* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and product presentation through order placement and follow-up
* Grow sales within existing accounts through regular store visits and relationship management
* Monitor inventory, pricing, promotions, and product placement at retail accounts
* Work with dispensary teams to identify opportunities to increase product visibility and sell-through
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, accounts, orders, and sales activity
* Stay informed on California cannabis regulations, market trends, competitive products, and retail dynamics
* Represent the brand professionally at dispensary visits, industry events, and other business-development opportunities
* Meet or exceed established sales and account-growth goals

What We're Looking For

* Proven outside sales experience; cannabis industry experience strongly preferred
* Existing relationships with California cannabis dispensaries and/or buyers is a major plus
* Strong understanding of the LA and/or Inland Empire cannabis retail market
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a field-sales environment
* Highly organized with strong follow-up and account-management skills
* Professional presentation and ability to represent a premium cannabis brand
* Comfortable with frequent local travel and visiting multiple accounts throughout the territory
* **Must have reliable transportation and a valid driver's license**
* **Must be able to travel throughout the Los Angeles and Inland Empire territories as needed**
* Must be **21+** and able to meet all applicable California cannabis industry requirements

**What is a “DIODE”**: noun. A specialized electronic component that allows an electric current to flow in only one direction.

**DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO FLOW IN THE RIGHT DIRECTION?**

DYODE is an industry-recognized eCommerce agency focused on web development, UX/UI design, strategic consulting, digital marketing, and merchandising. We lead with results, work hard, and strive for excellence. Founded by two former heads of eCommerce and staffed with over 30 industry veterans, we are motivated, ambitious, and continually growing to join forces with some of the biggest brands out there, like Glenmorangie, Bandai Namco Entertainment, NYDJ, Satechi, and Invisalign - just to name a few!

At DYODE, we are the anti-agency. Working at DYODE means joining an eCommerce solutions-based company with over 20+ years of experience. We strive for an inclusive culture by seizing every opportunity to provide flexible work schedules for our staff, creating an open community culture, streamlining our operations, and implementing new strategies to make your experience at DYODE the best. Your success is our success.

…

In this position, you will evangelize DYODE amongst critical business Partners and new prospective Clients. * Industry

* Update CRM Leads during sales lifecycle (source of truth)
* Call Notes
* Proposal Progress
* Email Updates
* Weekly / Monthly Lead Update Report
* Cold Calling, Email & LinkedIn Prospecting
* Copy for campaigns
* Monitoring performance and making changes as needed
* A/B testing
* Creating new campaigns
* Event Strategy Responsibilities
* Collaborate with the team on strategies for events and conferences
* Identify partners to target for events
* Prospect new brands to join events and existing customers as necessary
* Define pre-event strategy for communicating with prospects
* Define strategy for gathering leads and information during event
* Define post-event strategy for communicating with contacts made during event

…

We want you to succeed in this position and will help coach you in refining your skills. The ideal candidate would possess:

* 1-2 years of experience in sales. Knowledgeable in prospecting and lead nurturing, and comfortable picking up the phone for daily cold calling or visiting sales prospects in person as needed.
* Based locally in Orange County / Southern California and able to work in person from our Fullerton office. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with DYODE long term.
* Some knowledge of the eCommerce industry. Our ideal candidate is someone hungry to learn, but should be able to fluently speak e-commerce technology and digital marketing concepts within the first 6 months after training. Prior experience isn’t required, but a general understanding of Shopify and eCommerce concepts is a huge plus.
* Strong conceptual thinking. We want our team to be able to start projects off from an incredibly strong position and come up with unforeseen, clever concepts to move forward with. A deep level of care about the quality of your work and how it reflects on your character is the DYODE way.
* Strong self-management practices with meticulous attention to detail. Be able to deliver a solid approach to consistent, development ready work.
* Honesty, Integrity & Fairness. Respect for individual ability, creativity and diversity.
* A natural inclination to be proactive and take the lead in solving problems as you find them. A hunger for personal and professional growth.
* Strong communication skills (both written and verbal), discretion, professional openness, and other leadership skills needed to coordinate and facilitate healthy, well-organized teamwork.
* Having a sense of humor and being witty i

jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self-motivated, results-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
* Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical & analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work.
