jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Special Projects
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking an organized, proactive Executive Assistant & Special Projects professional to support the COO/Creative Director with meeting follow-through, project coordination, and company events. You will help turn the COO/Creative Director’s direction into clear next steps, keep teams informed, and ensure agreed tasks and approvals move forward.

Working closely with the COO/Creative Director and department leaders, you will coordinate a defined set of initiatives, including influencer collaborations and creative projects. The COO/Creative Director sets priorities and overall direction; you organize the details, anticipate next steps, and keep execution on track. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Executive Support**

* Email and calendar management
* Prepare materials for selected COO/Creative Director meetings, attend as needed, capture decisions, and confirm action items, owners, and deadlines.
* Maintain an action tracker, proactively follow up on commitments, and prepare concise updates on progress, decisions needed, and roadblocks.
* Gather materials and context for COO/Creative Director approvals, flag risks early, and recommend next steps when timelines or priorities shift.

**Operational & Administrative Support**

* Translate the COO/Creative Director’s direction into practical task lists and timelines, confirming responsibilities, required approvals, and budget needs.
* Coordinate assigned projects across departments from planning through completion, following up on deliverables and keeping the COO/Creative Director informed.
* Partner with creative and other teams to track agreed milestones, dependencies, and delivery dates.

**Special Projects**

* Marketing giveaways: Coordinate the development and execution of a marketing gift giveaway, including gift selection, vendor coordination, timelines, approvals, and delivery logistics.
* Influencer collaborations: Gather information help prepare proposed offers and coordinate the agreement under the COO/Creative Director’s direction; coordinate communications with influencers or their management teams, internal approvals, deliverables, and related events.
* Company Events: Plan and coordinate company events, including the holiday party: research vendors, gather quotes, prepare budget options, and manage logistics and execution following approval.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

**How we will work together**

* The COO/Creative Director and this role will agree on a focused list of active projects and review priorities and capacity weekly. New substantial assignments will include a discussion of what should be deferred or adjusted.
* Each project will have a defined objective, decision owner, and timeline. The COO/Creative Director retains final approval of major spending, commercial terms, and executive decisions.
* This role coordinates across departments; department leaders retain responsibility for their teams and functional decisions. Conflicting priorities are escalated to the COO/Creative Director for resolution.
* Work will be planned around agreed working hours. Occasional event-related work outside those hours will be discussed in advance, and event planning will be included in overall workload planning.
* The primary focus of the role is meeting preparation, follow-through, and project coordination; secondary focus would be to provide occasional scheduling assistance and personal administrative support to the COO/Creative Director as needed.

**What you bring**

* Relevant experience in executive assistance, project coordination, creative operations, or a similar role supporting senior leaders.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to turn direction into an actionable plan and complete agreed tasks without frequent prompting.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including concise status updates and clear recommendations.
* Comfort working with senior leaders, internal teams, vendors, and external partners, with discretion around confidential information.
* Good judgment about when to act independently, seek approval, or raise a capacity or timeline concern.
* Experience using shared trackers, spreadsheets, presentations, and project management tools.
* Experience with consumer brands, apparel, influencer partnerships, or company events is helpful.

**What success looks like**

The COO/Creative Director has clear visibility into priorities and fewer follow-ups to manage personally. Projects have accountable owners and realistic timelines; approvals arrive with the context needed to make decisions; and risks are raised early. Teams understand the next steps, and agreed initiatives and events are delivered within their approved scope and budget.

**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (HMO and PPO options)
* HSA/FSA
* Accrued paid time off
* Sick leave
* Paid Holidays
* Company Sponsored Retirement funds
* Employee discount on jeans

**Eligibility**

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor employment visas at any stage.

**Physical Requirements**

This role is primarily office-based and involves standard activities such as sitting, typing, attending meetings, and occasional lifting of items up to 20 pounds. We’re committed to providing reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities in performing essential job functions.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

* Employee discount

* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
We're ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you'll collaborate on some of the world's toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

**Summary:**

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**As Account Manager for ALTEN you will be responsible for sales and consulting services, recruitment, and management of engineering consultants in a professional and international environment. In short, your job will be to strive for happy ALTEN consultants and satisfied customers. By coaching your consultants and by creating continuous opportunities for them you create a dynamic and committed environment which helps stimulate business and support our customers.

ALTEN offers a well-defined career path which enables you as a manager to stay and grow professionally within the company. Other duties or tasks may be assigned as required. Management may modify, change or add to the duties of this description at any time without notice. The essential duties and responsibilities include the following:

**Supervisory Needs and Responsibilities**

* Creating new business opportunities by prospecting new customers within engineering sectors
* Manage existing account relationships supporting active Client projects
* Optimizing business profitability with mid-size accounts
* Close deals on service-based contracts (fixed-price, delivery-based) or on time-based contracts (delegation of consultants)
* Responsible for determining proposal and pricing strategy to close sales and win business. Support the company to meet its commercial objectives
* Continuously interview and match candidates to have already qualified talent ready to meet customer's current and anticipated needs
* Organizing & coordinating the commercial relationships with your partners
* Building close customer relationships and staying in close contact with customer managers to gain trust and develop business needs.
* Overseeing the consultant career evolution (annual review, training...)
* Building your own team of engineering consultants
* Ensure customer' satisfaction, project follow-up
* Manage your P&L statement for your business unit
* Work within Salesforce to track leads and sales performance data.
* Travel to existing and prospective customer sites to understand and develop solutions to support customer needs, with support from the technical team as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree is required, MSc or BSc degree in engineering or business is highly preferred
* 1-3 years of work experience
* Experience in cold calling and targeted business prospection efforts is preferred with ability to establish a network of relevant engineering contacts and customers.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to maintain strong business professional relationships. Strong analytical, organizational, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work under minimal supervision. Ability to work a flexible schedule as needed.
* Ability to be coachable and adaptable in a changing environment.

**Salary Range: $75,000-$85,000 + 25k Bonus**

The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate's combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

**MANDATORY FOR ALL REMOTE/HYBRID AND/OR CALIFORNIA, DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA, HAWAII, COLORADO, MARYLAND, CONNECTICUT, ILLINOIS, MINNESOTA, VERMONT, MASSACHUSETTS, NEVADA, NEW YORK, RHODE ISLAND, WASHINGTON STATE & CINCINNATI, OHIO, JERSEY CITY, NEW JERSEY, TOLEDO, OHIO BASED ROLES.**

jobs.description:
**FRESH. FORWARD. FLOWERS.**

Flowers Foods, Inc. (NYSE:FLO) is not just about baking; it's about crafting moments of joy with every delicious bite. With 2024 sales of $5.1 billion, and as one of the leading producers of packaged bakery goods in the United States, Flowers Foods brings passion to the table. From the wholesome goodness of Nature's Own and Wonder to the bold and artisanal flavors of Dave's Killer Bread, the rustic goodness of Canyon Bakehouse, and the sweet delights of Tastykake, each product is a celebration of taste and quality. Beyond the oven, Flowers Foods fosters a culture that values and reflects Honesty & Integrity, Respect & Inclusion, Sustainability, Passion, and Humility. With a commitment to innovation and a recipe for success, Flowers Foods is more than a bakery – it's a delightful journey into the heart of flavor and community.

**Full-time employees are offered the following benefits**:

* Comprehensive health and medical benefits
* 401(k) Retirement savings plan
* Professional growth and leadership training
* Paid vacation, holidays, and parental leave

*Benefits may vary depending on your work location.*

**Bringing Home the Dough**
---------------------------

Annual compensation is between $70,000 – $85,000 and is comprised of a base hourly wage plus commission.

Full-time employees are offered the following benefits:

* Comprehensive health and medical coverage
* 401(k) Retirement savings plan
* Professional growth and leadership training
* Paid vacation, holidays, and parental leave

**Rising to the Challenge: Position Responsibilities**
------------------------------------------------------

Flowers Bakeries Sales of NorCal, LLC has an immediate opening for a high-performing Route Sales Representative.

A Route Sales Representative (RSR) is responsible for ordering, sales, and delivery of fresh baked products. The successful candidate must come to work with a neat, professional appearance (sometimes in a uniform) and be able to build and maintain strong relationships with customers. Drivers will check their delivery vehicle daily, keeping accurate records, quickly reporting maintenance issues, and filling out daily driver’s logs, time logs, and hours of service.

This position will require flexibility to work varying workdays and early morning start times. Generally, start times are around 3:00am and days off are on Wednesday and Sunday.

An RSR is also expected to increase sales by expanding shelf space, creatively displaying in-store promotions and displays, and making sure product shelf life is maximized by properly rotating the products.

An effective RSR will use data and marketing plans to build relationships and drive customer growth through effective communication, planning, ordering, and execution. They will work together with the customers to increase sales and drive customer satisfaction. Adaptability and flexibility will be a must since RSRs will need to service their accounts during the customer’s designated service windows and may need to work non-traditional business hours to complete deliveries.

An eagerness to gain knowledge and skills about the industry along with the ability to work independently and as a team will be the key to success for an RSR working in a DSD (Direct Store Delivery) environment. Prior experience as a delivery driver will be beneficial for adapting to the demands of this role.

**Knead to Know: Preferred Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------

* Sales experience.
* Delivery driver experience.
* High school diploma or GED.

**Additional Ingredients: Essential Job Requirements**
------------------------------------------------------

* Must be at least 21 years of age.
* Have had a valid driver’s license for at least 3 years.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOT Medical Card.
* Must have a valid state driver’s license and documented safe driving record.
* Must meet Fleet Insurance Guidelines.
* Must adhere to federal, state, and local rules regarding the operation of a CMV.
* Must execute the best practices of RSR training (after 4-week company paid training).
* Must be able to push or pull up to 50 lbs. on a regular basis.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish is a plus, but not required.

Salary Range- $70,000 - $85,000/year

We offer a competitive salary and an excellent total rewards package. Interested job seekers who successfully complete the series of pre-screening questions and who appear to possess the basic qualifications for this position may be contacted for a telephone interview.

**EEO Statement**

Flowers is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Flowers encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, or people of any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. The job description above outlines the general nature and level of work expected from employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications for this position. Equivalent combination of education, experience, and skills may supplement above minimum job requirements.

If you need assistance with submitting your resume due to a medical condition or disability, please send an e-mail to Matthew West at Matthew.West@flocorp.com

jobs.title: Business Development & Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**About ADM Tech**

ADM Tech is the U.S. operating company of a cross-border e-commerce group with more than 20 years of experience building successful brands.

Our group owns and operates more than 10 proprietary brands across B2B technology, consumer products, lifestyle, outdoor, and other categories.

Many of these brands have already built strong online sales and customer demand. We are now expanding more aggressively into **offline B2B and retail channels**, including distributors, wholesalers, enterprise customers, Big Box retailers, and brick-and-mortar stores.

We are looking for a motivated **Business Development & Sales Representative** who wants to grow with the company and develop into a stronger B2B sales professional.

**What You’ll Do**

* Research and identify potential distributors, wholesalers, resellers, retailers, and enterprise customers
* Build prospect lists and identify the right decision-makers
* Conduct outbound outreach by email, phone, LinkedIn, and other channels
* Follow up consistently with potential customers and channel partners
* Help develop new accounts from initial contact through samples, quotations, negotiation, and order placement
* Support distributor and reseller relationships
* Assist with Key Account management and customer follow-up
* Coordinate with internal teams on product information, pricing, samples, inventory, logistics, and fulfillment
* Support trade shows, customer meetings, sales presentations, and new business projects
* Maintain CRM records, sales tracking, and opportunity follow-up
* Conduct market and competitor research to identify new opportunities

jobs.description:
**Description**

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self-motivated, results-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
* Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical & analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. **Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator, Lab Operations**
---------------------------------------

**Natera** | Entry-Level | Lab Operations

### **About Natera**

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, with diagnostic solutions spanning Women's Health, Oncology, Organ Health, and Rare Disease. Our work helps clinicians and patients make earlier, better-informed health decisions, and our teams are driven by the impact of that mission every day.

### **About the Role**

As a Project Coordinator on our Lab Operations team, you'll be the organizational backbone that keeps cross-functional projects moving. You'll support Program and Project Managers across a variety of department initiatives, handling the scheduling, documentation, and tracking that help teams deliver on time and within scope. This is an excellent entry point for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to project management in a fast-paced, science-driven environment.

### **What You'll Do**

* Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, capture meeting minutes, and maintain action item and decision logs
* Track project deliverables and follow up on document approvals, including design control documentation, under the direction of the Program Manager
* Maintain and update project schedules and Gantt charts to keep status and timelines accurate
* Schedule and coordinate project team meetings and manage logistics so issues are resolved quickly
* Adapt to shifting priorities and support multiple projects or programs as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 0–2 years of experience in a project support, administrative, or coordination role (internships and co-ops count)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working with cross-functional teams and leadership
* Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar productivity tools, and a willingness to learn new systems quickly
* A proactive, dependable, team-oriented approach

**Nice to Have**

* Coursework or exposure to life sciences, molecular biology, or genetics
* Familiarity with project tracking concepts such as Gantt charts, action item logs, or project schedules
* Experience with tools like Confluence, Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or SharePoint

### **Work Environment**

This is primarily an office-based role. You'll use a computer keyboard, communicate by phone and video, and read printed and digital material. Occasional work outside normal business hours, including evenings and weekends, may be required.

**OUR OPPORTUNITY**

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

*If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.*

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  
  
**Title:****Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30.00 - $34.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full-Time, (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt**  
  
**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16-24. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  
  
**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.

jobs.title: Internal Account Manager (INS852)
jobs.description:
We're looking for an **Internal Account Manager** to own client relationships at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, keeping placements on track, resolving issues before they escalate, and ensuring clients stay engaged and satisfied long after the initial hire.

This is a small business. There is no large team behind you and no playbook for every situation. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy, which means you make real decisions, handle real problems, and have a direct impact on whether clients stay and grow. If you are a confident communicator who takes ownership instinctively, moves fast when something needs attention, and wants a role where your judgment actually matters, this role is a strong fit.

**Why You'll Want to Join**

* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction and a strong client base
* High-ownership role with full autonomy over how you manage and grow your client portfolio

**What You'll Work On**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Own a portfolio of client accounts as the primary point of contact from placement through ongoing engagement
* Build strong, trust-based relationships that make clients feel supported and well-served
* Conduct regular check-ins and proactively surface any issues, risks, or opportunities before they become problems
* Keep clients informed, engaged, and confident in their placements without waiting for them to reach out first

**Issue Resolution and Escalation**

* Handle client concerns quickly and professionally, taking ownership of resolution rather than routing everything to someone else
* Identify patterns in client feedback and flag systemic issues to leadership with recommended fixes
* Coordinate internally across recruiting, operations, and leadership to resolve complex client situations
* Make judgment calls on when to escalate and when to handle directly

**Retention and Growth**

* Drive client retention by delivering a consistently high-quality account management experience
* Identify opportunities to expand relationships including additional placements, new roles, or expanded scope
* Track account health and flag at-risk clients early with a clear plan of action

**Reporting and Communication**

* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, account status, and open items
* Provide regular internal updates on portfolio health, client sentiment, and key risks
* Communicate clearly and professionally in writing and on calls across all client and internal interactions

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing role in a B2B environment
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a professional and responsive style
* High ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes rather than passing problems up or sideways
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business environment where processes are still being built and the answers are not always obvious
* Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously without losing track of anything
* Proactive and fast-moving with a bias toward action over deliberation when clients need support

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or workforce management
* Background working at a small business, startup, or founder-led company
* Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the dynamics of remote contractor placements
* Experience with CRM tools for tracking client interactions and account health

**How to Apply**

Please include:

* Your **updated resume**
* A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your account management or client success experience, and walking through how you handle a situation where a client is unhappy and you have to resolve it without escalating to leadership

**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

If you want full ownership over a client portfolio at a fast-moving company where your decisions actually matter and your impact is directly visible, this role gives you the autonomy and the scope to do your best work.

**Application Process Overview**

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

* **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
* **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
* **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
* **Recruitment Interview** - Initial screening with our talent team
* **Executive Interview** - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
* **Client Interview** - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
* **Background & Reference Check** - Professional reference verification
* **Job Offer** - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Launched in 2015, SpotHopper has quickly become the leading all-in-one marketing and operations platform for in-house teams to use at bars and restaurants. We work with nearly 20,000 restaurants and are one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the country.  
SpotHopper's all-in-one marketing and operations technology helps independent restaurants tackle the challenges they face online from one easy-to-use platform, saving them time and money. jobs.title: Deal and Contract Ops Manager, eero Business Operations
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are hiring a Deal and Contract Operations Manager to join our Business Operations team in San Francisco. In this role, you will design and own the end-to-end deal and contracting processes mainly by supporting and training deal owners on contracting workflows, including operational ownership of our contracting tool, acting as the escalation point before deals get stuck, coordinating across internal approver teams such as Legal, Tax, and Finance to keep deals moving forward, and ensuring every signed partner has a smooth onboarding experience by involving the right stakeholders pre- and post-close.  
  
Because you sit at the center of every deal, you will have a unique vantage point to spot what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled across the deal lifecycle, and coordinate with the rest of the functions under Bizops (i.e. Sales Ops, Order Management, Business Systems etc.) to make it happen. You will use that perspective to build frameworks, drive process automation, and continuously reduce the time it takes to get from contract signing to customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams like Partner Success, Order Management, and Logistics are engaged at the right time.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and maintain the end-to-end contract operations processes, from template selection support through approval alongside Legal so that deal owners (i.e. Business Development and Partner Success teams) can move deals through the process efficiently and with minimal friction.
* Project-manage deals from contract signing through customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams (Partner Success, Order Management, RevOps, Logistics) are engaged at the right time prior to deal close, and that non-standard terms are highlighted and passed along to the correct stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot Contract Lifecycle Management (i.e.) workflow issues, advise on routing and approvals, and unblock bottlenecks so deal owners can keep momentum.
* Train and equip Business Development teams to be self-sufficient in the contracting process: how to create CLM workflows, select the right contract template and deal term configuration, route to the correct approvers, and anticipate approval requirements
* Ensure contract templates are properly created and maintained within the CLM system in adherence with the Amazon policy, and assist Business Development with escalating redlines to Legal and driving alignment on accepted terms.
* Use your centralized vantage point across all deals to spot patterns and identify what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled, translating those insights into process improvements that make the entire deal lifecycle faster and more consistent.
* Lead process automation initiatives with the goal of decreasing contract throughput time and increasing deal signing velocity.
* Develop lightweight tooling and streamlined processes for higher-frequency, lower-complexity deals (e.g., direct Enterprise deals), including enabling 3P sales reps to independently handle NDAs and select contracting workflows on our behalf.
* Develop AI-based mechanisms to handle specialized deals with exception approvals for non-standard requests.
* Collaborate closely with Sales Ops and Order Management to feed process automation ideas and ensure the right tooling gets built to reduce manual effort across the deal-to-onboarding lifecycle.
* Continuously improve the onboarding experience for B2B customers by removing avoidable friction points, with decreasing time-to-onboard as a key success metric.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning checking in on active deals in Contract Central, spotting one that's waiting on Tax approval and flagging to the BD owner how long that step usually takes. By midday, you could be helping a Business Development lead pick the right contract template and approval routing for a non-standard deal, or bringing Partner Success and Order Management in ahead of a signing so onboarding starts smoothly. Afternoons often involve working with Legal, Finance, and Sales Ops to clear a recurring bottleneck, followed by turning what you've seen across deals into a standard workflow or an automation idea. You will regularly train deal owners on contracting best practices and present recommendations to leaders on reducing time from signing to onboarding.  
  
About the team  
Our team keeps eero's partner deals and orders moving, from contract signing through delivery. As part of eero Business Operations, we work closely with Business Development, Partner Success, Legal, Finance, Order Management, and Logistics teams to build the processes and tools that help ISPs, Enterprise customers, and retail partners around the world get eero into their customers' homes and businesses. We value ownership, creative problem-solving, and using AI and automation to take manual work off our plates so we can focus on our partners. As we grow into new channels and regions, you will have the opportunity to shape how we scale deal and contract operations.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
* 3+ years of experience in operations or program management that is GTM and business team facing.
* Working familiarity with contracts approval tools, like Amazon’s Contract Central, or the like
* Hands-on experience in ushering deals from contracts signing through successful onboarding by involving the right stakeholders at the right time.
* Experience translating legal, tax and finance requirements in

jobs.title: B2B Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Social Media Specialist to run organic and paid LinkedIn programs for B2B tech companies and the high-profile executives who lead them.

### **About Firebrand Communications**

Firebrand is the brand awareness agency for AI companies. We make AI firms visible, discoverable and memorable to prospects, investors, talent and partners. We build awareness for B2B AI companies through integrated programs involving PR, SEO/GEO, social and paid media. We are a true partner in brand awareness marketing, from guiding and optimizing strategy to executing quickly and confidently. Through our seasoned team, rich partner ecosystem, strong connections, and custom AI agents, we help brands not just show up, but stand out. Firebrand is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

### **Description**

You can expect an entrepreneurial culture, to work directly with a senior team, to be strategic and hands-on, and to help build a fantastic firm. We have no politics, no bureaucracy, efficient systems, and a supportive approach. We focus on great work, high levels of client service, and expanding our skills. The agency is AI-forward with a range of custom apps and agents, and we expect all our team members to be fluent with AI workflows.

We work with high-growth B2B AI companies, many of them backed by prominent VCs including a16z, GV, LightSpeed and Menlo Ventures. Currently, clients operate in sectors such as enterprise AI, AI infrastructure, robotics/physical AI, analytics and fintech.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a **Social Media Specialist** to run organic and paid LinkedIn programs for B2B tech companies and the high-profile executives who lead them. This role suits a junior marketer with solid hands-on experience, who knows what great B2B content looks like on LinkedIn and can turn an executive’s expertise into a consistent, credible voice that builds reach, reputation and pipeline.

You will bring superb writing skills, a sharp eye for editing, confident use of AI tools, and an analytical approach to social programs across company pages, executive profiles, LinkedIn Ads and B2B influencer partnerships. Most of our campaigns are integrated across PR, SEO/GEO, social and paid media, so you’ll get plenty of exposure to other disciplines.

This role reports to our SVP of Digital Marketing and typically works across three to five clients.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* *Company page social* - develop and execute organic LinkedIn strategies for multiple B2B tech client company pages, including strategy, editorial calendar planning, content creation, publishing, community management and optimization.
* *Executive social* - own social media strategy and execution for high-profile B2B tech executives (CEOs, founders, CMOs and other C-suite leaders), including profile optimization, ghostwritten posts, engagement and commenting strategy, and developing each executive’s distinctive voice and point of view.
* *Copywriting & editing* - craft sharp, scroll-stopping copy for posts, carousels, ads, video scripts and newsletters, and edit client and executive drafts to tighten messaging and match each voice. Enhanced by, but not relying on, AI.
* *AI-assisted content* - use AI tools, agents and skills (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, custom GPTs and agents) to research, ideate, draft, edit and repurpose content at scale, while protecting quality, accuracy and brand voice.
* *Paid social (LinkedIn)* - plan, build and optimize LinkedIn Ads campaigns end to end, including audience targeting (matched audiences, ABM lists, retargeting), ad formats (Thought Leader Ads, document ads, video, lead gen forms), budget pacing, A/B testing and ongoing optimization.
* *B2B influencer programs* - identify and vet relevant B2B creators and influencers, manage outreach, co-write and approve content, coordinate partnerships and report on results.
* *Tools & publishing* - manage scheduling, publishing, social listening and analytics through platforms such as HubSpot, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Taplio or similar.
* *Client management & presenting* - work directly with clients and executives, presenting strategies, content plans and performance results clearly and confidently.
* *Reporting* - build regular performance reports across company page, executive and paid social, translating metrics (reach, engagement, follower growth, CTR, CPL, pipeline influence) into clear insights and recommendations.

**Requirements**
----------------

* *Experience:* 2-4 years' relevant social media experience (emphasis on B2B tech and LinkedIn). Agency experience preferred
* *Executive Social:* Demonstrable experience managing LinkedIn for senior executives as well as company pages, with portfolio examples
* *LinkedIn Ads:* Hands-on experience in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, from strategy and campaign build through optimization and reporting
* *Tech Experience:* Familiarity with the B2B tech sector, ideally including working with AI companies
* *Education:* Solid academic track record at least to Bachelor's degree level
* *AI Fluency:* Confident, practical user of AI for content creation and editing, with curiosity about agents, skills and new workflows.
* *Adaptability & Agility*: Comfortable operating in fast-paced startup environments while balancing multiple clients, executives and content calendars.
* *Strong Communication:* Clear, persuasive communicator who can present strategy and performance insights confidently to clients and senior executives.
* *Bonus – Reddit:* Experience with organic Reddit strategy for B2B brands, including subreddit research and authentic community engagement.

**Benefits**
------------

* 20 days' vacation
* Health, dental and vision care
* Company 401(k) with 3% non-elective contribution

The agency is headquartered in San Francisco, California. We are currently working in a remote-first model but require a Bay Area location for client meetings, in-office meetings and get-toget

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We’re searching for an Executive Assistant.

**In this role, you will**

* **Manage complex, dynamic calendars:** Plan, coordinate, and safeguard executive schedules, striking the ideal balance between "gatekeeper" and "gateway."
* **Prioritize commitments:** Exercise sound judgment to optimize leaders' time across competing internal and external demands.
* **Oversee end-to-end travel:** Book and manage flights, lodging, and ground transportation; handle last-minute adjustments seamlessly while ensuring compliance with corporate travel policy.
* **Drive meeting efficiency:** Gather agenda topics, participate in leadership-level meetings, and record concise, high-level notes that synthesize key decisions and drive clear task ownership.
* **Ensure thorough follow-through:** Proactively take ownership of post-meeting action items and follow up with cross-functional teams with minimal direction.
* **Prepare communications and materials:** Assist with the development of presentation decks, internal documentation, and executive communications.
* **Optimize candidate scheduling:** Assess necessity, urgency, and interview frequency when coordinating candidate meetings with leaders.
* **Manage expenses:** Prepare and submit executive expense reports; review and approve team expenses to ensure alignment with company policy.
* **Coordinate events and logistics:** Plan and execute team offsites, onsites, and special events.
* **Provide guest hospitality:** Warmly greet and accommodate visitors with a professional and welcoming demeanor.
* **Support onboarding:** Assist with the smooth onboarding of new hires reporting directly to executives.
* **Serve as a strategic liaison:** Act as a trusted partner, facilitator, and central point of contact for leaders, their teams, and the broader organization.
* **Navigate ambiguity and anticipate needs:** Proactively identify team priorities, stay ahead of shifting schedules, and adapt swiftly in a fast-paced environment.
* **Uphold confidentiality and transparency:** Handle sensitive information with utmost discretion while fostering an open, collaborative culture.
* **Drive process improvements:** Identify inefficiencies and introduce new operational workflows when appropriate.
* **Lead special initiatives:** Drive or support key projects for executive leaders and the broader Administration (EA) Department.
* **Foster culture:** Champion team-building initiatives, boost morale, and exemplify core company values.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Calendar Management:** Proven track record of managing complex executive calendars across multiple time zones.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interface confidently with executives and external partners.
* **Attention to Detail:** High precision in document preparation, meeting logistics, and task tracking.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Quick learner with expertise in modern productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Slack, spreadsheet analysis, slide decks).
* **Problem-Solving & Initiative:** Creative problem-solver and proactive self-starter who thrives in high-autonomy environments.
* **Composure Under Pressure:** Ability to remain calm, collaborative, and decisive under tight deadlines or high-stress situations.
* **Strategic Foresight & Judgment:** Strong business acumen, active foresight, and sound decision-making abilities.
* **Professionalism & Discretion:** Exemplary professionalism, executive presence, and utmost discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.
* **Team Collaboration & Autonomy:** Highly resourceful team player who operates effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team.
* **Project Coordination:** Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional projects and offsite events.
* **Flexibility:** Willingness to provide occasional off-hours support as urgent business needs arise.
* **Travel:** Willingness to travel occasionally for company offsites or team gatherings.

*For roles based in Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $96,000 - $172,000 per year.

*For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $87,000 - $155,000 per year.
  
  
Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

**Working at Aurora**

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational need

At Applegreen, our mission is to delight customers in transit with passionate hospitality and brands they love.

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery

* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

**Reports To**: Project Director

**GENERAL STATEMENT OF RESPONSIBILITIES**

The project coordinator works as part of CAI’s National Technical Assistance Program (NTAP) for Clinical and Preventive Excellence team, which helps health centers nationwide strengthen primary care access, improve clinical quality, expand preventive services, and achieve better health outcomes for patients. This requires someone with strong organizational and communication skills.

**MAJOR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES (include, but are not limited to):**

***Training, Technical Assistance, Meeting, and Event Coordination and Support***

Provide coordination and support to project teams in planning and delivery of in-person and web-based training and technical assistance (TTA), meetings and events (e.g. virtual – instructor led training (V-ILT), face-to-face classroom training, webinars, learning collaboratives, presentations, and conference exhibits). This involves intensive training in Zoom producing and utilizing Learning Stream, our training management system, among other software. Tasks include the following:

*General Responsibilities*

* Schedule in-person and virtual trainings, TA, and meetings.
* Implement processes for facilitating registration and cancellations of participants using online registration system(s) and responding to, and trouble-shooting, participant registration and cancellation questions.
* In coordination with Clinical Division staff, prepare and manage continuing education applications and training attendee credit requests.
* Prepare training materials using JobMaster and/or by facilitating printing and forwarding to participants via email or US postal service.
* Make travel arrangements for training staff and/or participants as required.

*Virtual Instructor Led Training (V-ILT) Producer*

Using Zoom and/or other virtual learning platforms, the producer, works as part of the training team, in concert with trainers, to cover all the technical elements of the training to make the V-ILT session run smoothly allowing the facilitator to deliver the session objectives and guide the learners through the session content. Tasks may include:

* Schedule and facilitate training team practice runs and training debriefs.
* Load, before the event, and run polling during the event.
* Guiding participants through an introduction to use of technology.
* Onboard participants and presenters/trainers (e.g., audio checks, on-boarding late participants) during the event.
* Troubleshoot and address participant and trainer technical issues during the event (e.g., muting microphones to mitigate background noise) as they arise.
* Create and run break-out sessions during the event.
* Share links to tasks and documents during the event.
* Download and file/post/disseminate chats, polls, archived products, and recordings of virtual trainings, meetings, events as identified.
* Record and facilitate editing of training events for dissemination.

*In-person Trainings and Meetings*

* Identify and secure in-person meeting venues, negotiating on space and price.
* Coordinate travel arrangements and reimbursements for in-person convenings.
* Ensure set-up of meeting space is implemented according to lead trainer instructions.
* Work with IT to ensure all AV equipment (e.g., laptop, microphones, screens) are available for day of training.
* Order food and refreshments, as allowed, and
* On day of training support trainer in ensuring all equipment, room set-up, and materials are set-up and provide support to participants and training team throughout (e.g., registration table, printing materials, working with venue staff)

***Evaluation Support***

* Work with research and evaluation staff to meet funder specifications for reporting and foster continuous quality improvement.
* Upload, gather, and disseminate to project team, data from different sources to help inform progress in achievement of project deliverables. This involves conducting data entry and uploading participant registration and TTA evaluations in project management database (i.e. Quickbase) and downloading reports from participant registration systems, TTA evaluation results, communications analytics (Formstack), GetResponse, website, and social media, and among other sources.

***Communications Support***

* Work closely with communications staff on the development and design for project communications activities.
* Coordinate project communication activities, including:
* Updating project website.
* Drafting and sending out email announcements using GetResponse.
* Using social media to promote project activities.
* Support efforts to package materials (e.g., iStock images)
* Exhibits at national and regional conferences.

***Project Management Support***

* Assist project director, as identified, with fostering communication with funder and partner organizations, including with the development of funder reports.
* Manage the process for hiring of consultants, ensuring that completed paperwork is provided to finance and human resources staff.
* Facilitate communication among and schedule meetings of project staff via teams or Zoom or in-persons.
* Keep accurate and organized records of meeting minutes and project activities using QuickBase and Sharepoint.
* Work with project director, project staff, and finance department to organize and manage project expenses using Intacct, including reconciling expenses on a monthly basis.
* Order supplies.
* With support from IT troubleshoot and address IT challenges among project team.
* Travel for project-related events, meetings, and trainings as needed.
