* Conduct regular face-to-face meetings with automotive dealerships and other targeted accounts to understand their needs and present relevant products and solutions.
* Build a strong pipeline through prospecting, cold calling, networking, referrals, and consistent follow-up with high-potential accounts.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, product demonstrations, samples, and proposals tailored to each customer's needs.
* Plan efficient weekly routes and maintain a consistent seven-week travel cycle across Greater Chicago, Central Illinois, and Wisconsin.
* Identify at least 40 targeted customer and prospect accounts for each field week and maintain consistent follow-up throughout the sales cycle.
* Maintain accurate and timely CRM records of sales activity, customer interactions, follow-up commitments, and pipeline status.
* Partner with Marketing, Customer Service, Reorders, and Product Development to support new business, recurring orders, and the resolution of customer needs.
* Share market intelligence, competitive activity, customer feedback, and emerging opportunities to support product and marketing strategies.

**What We're Looking For**

* Must reside within the Greater Chicagoland Area.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in field sales, outside sales, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role; B2B sales experience strongly preferred.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and the ability to travel throughout the assigned territory.
* Ability and willingness to follow the seven-week territory rotation, including approximately two weeks of overnight travel per cycle in Central Illinois and Wisconsin.
* Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation, negotiation, and consultative selling skills.
* Demonstrated initiative and persistence in developing new business and working toward measurable sales goals.
* Excellent organization and time management, including the ability to plan routes, prioritize accounts, and follow through consistently.
* Comfort working independently in the field while collaborating effectively with a broader team.
* Experience using CRM software such as Salesforce or GoldMine and proficiency with digital sales and reporting tools preferred.
* Automotive dealership, promotional products, or related industry experience preferred.

**The Values We Look For**

We seek team members who demonstrate:

* A passion for learning, improving, and delivering results.
* A desire to contribute to the success of the larger team.
* Enthusiasm for solving challenges and finding solutions.
* Respect for coworkers and collaboration across departments.
* Commitment to supporting LaFrance Corp and living our core values.

**Why Join LaFrance Corp?**

**Benefits**

For more than 75 years, LaFrance Corp has built long-term relationships with leading global brands by combining creativity, technical expertise, manufacturing capability, and strong customer service.

We offer a casual yet professional work environment where teamwork, problem-solving, and internal growth are valued. Promotion from within is an important part of our culture, and employees have opportunities to participate in wellness initiatives, community volunteer activities, company events, and culture teams.

jobs.title: New PSA Service Sales Representative 3
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

**PSA Service Sales Representative**
------------------------------------

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we help elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and move society forward.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking a Service Sales Representative to promote and sell service agreements for commercial building systems products, including fire alarm, suppression, sprinkler, security, sound, communication, and inspections. In this role, you will build customer relationships, develop opportunities, and support the sales process from prospecting through contract close and ongoing account service.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Promote and sell service agreements for commercial building systems to an assigned customer base.
* Establish contact with prospects, qualify potential buyers, and follow up on leads using planned sales activities and marketing strategies.
* Develop a positive ongoing relationship with customers to understand needs and support long-term retention.
* Create sales strategies that align Johnson Controls service offerings with customer requirements and decision drivers.
* Close sufficient sales to meet sales plan objectives and maintain an active proposal backlog.
* Conduct building surveys to support estimate development and proposal accuracy.
* Maintain accurate and complete records of all sales-related activities.
* Submit sales reports, expenses, competitive activity, and correspondence accurately and on time.
* Support the service department by generating leads for service or equipment and device upgrades.
* Collaborate with service, technical, design engineering, support, and management teams to deliver a strong customer experience.

**How You Will Do It**
----------------------

  

* You will work with discipline and accountability by managing your pipeline, following through on commitments, and keeping records, reporting, and customer communication current.
* You will stay close to the customer’s work by listening carefully, conducting building surveys, and aligning service solutions to real operational needs.
* You will prospect with consistency by scheduling sales calls, following up on leads, and using approved marketing strategies to uncover new opportunities.
* You will improve outcomes through candor and problem-solving by reviewing competitive activity, refining your approach, and identifying service or upgrade opportunities.
* You will win as one team by working closely with internal partners to remove obstacles for customers and support long-term service success.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Degree or equivalent work experience, typically 5 years.
* At least 5 years of B2B sales experience with a proven track record.
* Experience selling a service, intangible, or technical product.
* Experience prospecting, qualifying, solution selling, and closing deals.
* Ability to work in a matrix environment with minimal direction and meet quota-based performance expectations.
* Strong professional communication, interpersonal, and time management skills.
* Proficiency with personal computers, including Windows and Oracle systems.
* Ability and willingness to work as a teammate and collaborate well with others.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business discipline.
* Experience in the industry or a related industry.
* Salesforce proficiency.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

We offer a competitive salary, 15 days of vacation in the first year, and a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k), medical, dental, and vision care available day one. You’ll also find an encouraging and collaborative team environment, dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy, and on-the-job and cross-training opportunities that support your growth.

If you are ready to build trusted customer relationships and help grow service solutions for commercial building systems, we’d love to hear from you.

**HIRING SALARY RANGE: $ 55k- $72K** (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) **This role also offers a competitive Sales Incentive Plan that will take into account volume and margin on a project, quarterly, and annual basis**. This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. **If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply.** To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers. For details, please visit the About Us tab on the Johnson Controls Careers site at https://jobs.johnsoncontrols.com/about-us

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Overview:

As a direct report to the Area Sales Manager, the Business Development Representative will drive the acquisition of new customers and facilitate the expansion of existing accounts within the local market. This role requires a passionate sales professional who excels in identifying and expanding opportunities proactively and cultivating strong, enduring relationships with customers. This role will develop a deep understanding of TrueBlue’s offerings and how we solve customer problems.

Location: Bolingbrook, IL

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Actively prospect and acquire new customers within the designated territory through effective networking and lead development.  
Identify growth opportunities and prospects for new customer acquisition.  
Enhance customer loyalty and drive account growth by developing relationships with customers.  
Implement strategic sales initiatives to meet and surpass sales targets.  
Consult with customers to understand their business needs and offer creative solutions to solve workforce needs Effectively sell the PeopleReady service offerings.  
Collaborate with PeopleReady contracts and legal teams to negotiate contract terms effectively.  
Ensure competitive bill rates and margins are applied to all customer contracts.  
Ensure the appropriate branch is aware of any unique, differentiating customer details.  
Proactively solution cross sell opportunities across all TrueBlue brands and neighboring markets.  
Develop account management and sales strategies to increase share of wallet and customer retention.  
Lead formal business reviews with key customers to assess performance and identify growth opportunities.  
Utilize appropriate technology and tools to develop and maintain comprehensive account management and growth strategies.  
Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments to effectively position TrueBlue products/services.  
Mentor other sales reps and client facing employees.

Education and Experience

Three or more years related sales experience; Bachelors, associate degree; or equivalent combination of education and experience.  
Managed a portfolio of at least $2.5M per annum.  
Sales experience in one or more blue-collar market verticals.  
Proven track record of exceeding sales targets.  
Experience in understanding, adapting, and applying new technologies.  
Valid driver license, registered vehicle, and vehicle insurance.

Core Knowledge and Skills

Communicates clearly, concisely, and professionally in both written and verbal forms  
Adept at persuading diverse customer stakeholders  
Strong organizational skills with attention to detail  
Capable of prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines effectively under pressure  
Analytical abilities: skilled in analyzing order, associate, and customer data to drive informed decisions and achieve outcomes  
Competitive drive  
Capable of establishing rapport with a wide range of individuals  
Understand multiple, diverse perspectives from clients  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and Salesforce.com, leveraging technology for efficient sales management and reporting

Work Environment and Physical Demands

This role operates with a remote work structure, but it is fundamentally a field-based sales position. The employee will be expected to dedicate over 50% of their time to outside sales activities and client engagement.  
Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk, and/or hear for long periods of time. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.  
Travel is required as part of the job. Visits to customer sites or local branches required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position will not have any direct supervisory responsibilities.

Salary Range: $60,000 - $72,000 annually, depending on experience and geographic location plus eligibility for incentive pay, subject to plan terms. This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

Please note that actual compensation offered may vary based on local pay requirements and will meet or exceed state-specific minimum wage or salary thresholds.

Benefits and Well-Being:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. More details about our benefits can be found here .

We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law.

You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full-time basis.

TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands welcome and encourage applications from candidates with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in the application or interview process. If you require disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your Recruiter directly, Employee Relations at HR-Advice@trueblue.com , or 1-800-610-8920. TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands will consult with all applicants who request disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process to ensure that the accommodation provided takes into account the applicant’s individual accessibility needs.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Air Freight Operations Assistant Manager - Import & Export
jobs.description:
**About Toll Group**

At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.com

**PURPOSE OF THE JOB**

The Air Freight Operations Assistant Manager is responsible for managing complex air freight operations across import, export, and domestic transport activities. This role ensures timely and compliant cargo movement, accurate documentation, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The senior coordinator also provides guidance to junior team members and contributes to process improvements and cost efficiency.

**PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage end-to-end air freight operations for import/export, including booking, documentation, and dispatch for priority or complex shipments.
* Liaise with airlines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and transport providers to ensure smooth cargo movement and compliance with regulations.
* Prepare and review air waybills, customs declarations, and other critical documentation.
* Monitor shipment progress, proactively address delays or disruptions, and communicate solutions to customers and stakeholders.
* Coordinate cargo pick-ups and deliveries, including local transport and warehouse interactions.
* Oversee job management including WIPS, accruals, cost control, and timely closures.
* Validate and approve customer invoices, reports, and creditor payments; identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and ensure timely updates in internal systems (e.g., CargoWise One).
* Ensure adherence to customs, quarantine, and aviation regulations; provide guidance on compliance matters.
* Respond to customer inquiries and maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operational best practices.
* Mentor and support junior coordinators, fostering a collaborative team environment.
* Demonstrate commercial awareness by analyzing job profitability and supporting financial performance.

**Previous Work Experience** **& Qualifications**

* 3–5 years’ experience in air freight operations, with exposure to complex or high-volume shipments.
* Strong understanding of customs and aviation regulations.
* Proficiency in freight management systems (e.g., CargoWise One) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Proven ability to work independently and guide junior team members.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong relationship management skills.

**What moves you?**

At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.

Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don’t meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.

At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.

To find out more about us visit www.careers.tollgroup.com

You must be entitled to work in United States of America and be prepared to undertake pre-employment checks including a criminal history check and medical.

jobs.title: FULL-TIME Culinary Development Assistant | Cook/Baker | $22–$27/hr | M–F, 7am–3pm
jobs.description:
**Culinary Development Assistant**

**Firenze Italian Street Food | Chicago, IL**  
**Full-Time | $22–$27/hour**

Do you love making food people crave? And are you good at it?

Firenze is looking for a **hardworking, curious food person** who wants to cook, bake, learn, experiment and grow with us.

You don't need R&D experience or to know everything about developing food for a growing business. **But you should already be someone who can cook or bake really well and has a natural feel for what makes food taste great.**

You'll be a utility player across our food operation. Depending on the week, you could be working on food development, prepping with our kitchen team, helping with a big catering order or jumping on the line during lunch.

You might spend one morning testing three different ways to roast a vegetable. Another day you might help execute a large catering order and then spend the afternoon making the next version of a new product.

**About Firenze**

Firenze is a growing Chicago fast-casual restaurant and catering company inspired by the food and spirit of Florence.

Our goal is to make **craveable, high-quality food with clean ingredients that is accessible enough to eat every day.**

We like simple food done really well: great ingredients, good technique and attention to the details.

That might mean taking something as simple as a roasted sweet potato and testing the variety, cooking method, seasoning and timing until it's really good — then figuring out how we make it just as well every time.

We're growing quickly and we're still small enough to move fast. **If we have a good idea, we can test it tomorrow.**

**What you'll do**

The mix will change from week to week. That's part of the job.

You could be:

* Testing new recipes and improving food we already serve
* Making a few versions of something and tasting them side by side
* Prepping and cooking alongside our kitchen team
* Helping with large catering orders
* Jumping on the line during a busy lunch
* Comparing ingredients or products we like
* Weighing ingredients and tracking yields
* Testing how food tastes and holds over time
* Taking accurate notes so we know exactly what worked
* Helping take something from a small test to hundreds of portions

We think you get better at developing food by actually working in the operation. Making something great for 5 people is different from making it great for 500. You'll learn both.

**Who we're looking for**

You might be a cook, baker, pastry cook, prep cook, line cook, culinary-school graduate, **a serious home cook who makes great food**, or someone with a different food background who's ready for something new.

**We're open to both cooking and baking backgrounds.** We like the precision and consistency that often come from baking, and the food and flavor instincts that come from cooking.

We're looking for someone who:

* **Makes really good food.** You have strong food instincts, care deeply about quality and know how to make something people genuinely want to eat again.
* **Cares about the details behind great food.** You want to understand why something tastes great, how ingredients and technique affect it, how it holds over time and how to make it consistently the right way.
* **Has a great attitude.** You're willing to jump in and help, and no job is beneath you.
* **Works hard.** You like being productive and don't need someone constantly pushing you.
* **Cares about making an impact.** You want your work to matter and like seeing something you helped improve actually get used.
* **Can be consistent.** Making something great once isn't enough. You can make it great again and again.
* **Is curious and resourceful.** You ask questions and figure things out when you don't know.
* **Takes feedback well.** You're happy to make another version rather than getting attached to the first one.
* **Works well with others.** You can take direction, communicate clearly and work closely with our culinary and leadership teams.
* **Keeps accurate records.** You can weigh, measure and keep good notes on exactly what you did.
* **Likes variety.** You're happy testing food one day and jumping in wherever the team needs you the next.
* **Wants to grow.** You're looking to learn and take on more responsibility.

**Professional kitchen, bakery or food-development experience is helpful but not required.**

**Learn and grow with us**

We want this to be a place where you become much better at what you do.

You'll get experience with food development, cooking, sourcing, recipe testing, yields, food cost, production, catering and restaurant service.

We'll invest in helping you learn too. That could mean working alongside experienced chefs and specialists, learning directly from suppliers, or even doing **paid stages with other chefs to develop specific skills.**

If you show us you can handle more, **we'll give you more — more responsibility and more pay.**

**Schedule & pay**

* Full-time, approximately **35–40 hours per week**
* Primarily Monday–Friday
* Typical schedule is approximately **7:00 AM–3:00 PM**
* Occasional weekend work may be needed
* **$22–$27/hour depending on experience**
* Overtime paid for hours worked over 40
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Paid time off and standard company benefits

This is an active kitchen role. You should be comfortable being on your feet for extended periods and lifting up to 50 pounds.

**A valid driver's license and reliable access to a car are strongly preferred**, as the role may occasionally involve picking up ingredients, visiting suppliers or traveling to other kitchens for training and development.

Food Handler certification is required or must be obtained within 30 days of starting.

**To apply**

Send your résumé and a short answer to the question below to **catering@firenzestreetfood.com**:

**What's one seemingly simple food you've made noticeably better?**

It can be something you made at work or at home — eggs, chick

Since 2018, the dedicated team at Natural Green Technology (NGT) has been committed to providing top-quality packaging solutions, including Mylar bags, labels, shrink wraps, and boxes, to the Cosmetics, Food & Beverage, Pet, Tobacco, Medicine/Pharmaceuticals, Cannabis industries.

The Sales Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative, operational, and client-service support to the Sales & Marketing team. Sales & Administrative Support

· Handle incoming sales calls and inquiries, assist with lead qualification, document opportunities, and route qualified business to the appropriate sales manager.

· Maintain accurate client, account, group, event, reservation, rate, and operational information across hotel systems.

· Prepare meeting materials, reports, correspondence, documentation, and other materials required for sales and operational meetings.

new_jobs.title: Mental Health Program Specialist 2, Central Office;
new_jobs.description:
Duties Description The New York State Office of Mental Health (OMH) is currently recruiting to fill Mental Health Program Specialist 2, Grade 23, positions in the New York City Field Office. The incumbents will be assigned to the Licensing/Certification Unit within the Field Office and, based on assignments, will be required to travel. Specific duties to be performed may include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  
Conduct on-site reviews of licensed mental health programs including inpatient, outpatient and community residential facilities to determine compliance with OMH regulations and Standards of Care.
  
  
Prepare final recommendations and written reports for renewal of program’s certification and the issuance of an operating certificate.
  
  
Collaborate with other units within the OMH Field Office and staff of OMH Central Office on completing licensing and recertification tasks, monitoring of programs and ensuring adequate follow up, as well as review and monitoring of program’s Performance Improvement Plan.
  
  
Interpret OMH policy as it applies to specific situations involving State and local providers and provide technical assistance to programs licensed by OMH.
  
  
Participate in review of Prior Approval Review applications, Administrative Actions, and Request for Proposals, as appropriate.
  
  
Participate in special projects as assigned, as well as system transformation initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications Non-Competitive Minimum Qualifications Under the NY HELPS Program:
  
To be eligible for appointment, candidates must have a bachelor's degree in child and family studies, counseling and community psychology, creative arts therapy, criminal justice, health administration, hospital administration, marriage and family therapy, mental health counseling, nursing, psychoanalysis, psychology, public administration, public health, public policy, recreation therapy, rehabilitation counseling, social work, sociology, or special education AND three years of professional clinical or administrative experience in a federal or state operated, licensed, certified, or funded mental health program.
  
  
A master's degree in child and family studies, counseling and community psychology, creative arts therapy, criminal justice, health administration, hospital administration, marriage and family therapy, mental health counseling, nursing, psychoanalysis, psychology, public administration, public health, public policy, recreation therapy, rehabilitation counseling, social work, sociology, or special education can subsitute for one year of specialized experience.
  
  
Transfer Opportunity:
  
Candidates must have one year of permanent competitive or 55b/c service as a Mental Health Program Specialist 2, G-23, and be eligible for lateral transfer; OR be eligible to transfer via Section 70.1 of the Civil Service Law by having one year of permanent competitive or 55b/c service in a qualifying title within two salary grades or one M-grade of the Grade 23 level.
  
  
55b/c Opportunity:
  
Individuals certified eligible for the 55b/c program under the Governor’s Program to Hire Persons/Veterans with Disabilities pursuant to Section 55b/c of the Civil Service Law will also be considered. In addition to a current 55b/c eligibility letter, candidates must possess a Bachelor's or higher degree in child and family studies, counseling and community psychology, creative arts therapy, criminal justice, health administration, hospital administration, marriage and family therapy, mental health counseling, nursing, psychoanalysis, psychology, public administration, public health, public policy, recreation therapy, rehabilitation counseling, social work, sociology, or special education AND three years of professional clinical or administrative experience in a mental health program. Please provide a copy of your eligibility letter with your application.

Additional Comments Specific scheduled hours and telecommuting availability for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Please note, employees are required to apply and obtain approval through management to telecommute according to operational needs and Agency Telecommuting Program Guidelines.
  
  
The Mission of the New York State Office of Mental Health is to promote the mental health of all New Yorkers, with a focus on providing hope and supporting recovery for adults with serious mental illness and children with serious emotional disturbances. Applicants with lived mental health experience are encouraged to apply. OMH is deeply committed to supporting underserved individuals, organizations, and communities. To this end, OMH is focused on implementing activities and initiatives to reduce disparities in access, quality, and treatment outcomes for underserved populations. A critical component of these efforts is ensuring OMH is a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees' unique attributes and skills are valued and utilized to support the mission of the Agency. OMH is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.
  
  
This title is part of the New York Hiring for Emergency Limited Placement Statewide Program (NY HELPS).

Some positions may require additional credentials or a background check to verify your identity.
